title: Configuration/Settings Layer Tests
description: Create unit tests for 3 configuration modules and 1 settings module covering: (1) configuration-monitor.test.ts with 6 scenarios (provider key routing, base config routing, features routing, mixed key handling, unknown key filtering, dispose cleanup); (2) settings-sync-service.test.ts with 6 scenarios (key parsing, non-sync field rejection, key classification, syncFromSettingsJson, syncToSettingsJson, anti-loop protection); (3) features-settings-manager.test.ts with 3 scenarios (default merging, getSettings merge, updateSettings persistence); (4) additional config-service.test.ts and profile-manager-service.test.ts if time permits.

criteria: 3 MUST-have test files created: [configuration-monitor.test.ts, settings-sync-service.test.ts, features-settings-manager.test.ts] — verify by ls src/config/services/__tests__/*.test.ts src/services/settings/__tests__/*.test.ts | wc -l >= 3
configuration-monitor covers all key type routing: [providers, base, features, mixed, unknown] — verify by grep 'provider\|base\.\|features\|mixed\|unknown' in test
settings-sync-service anti-loop protection tested — verify by grep 'anti-loop\|_syncSource\|loop' in test
features-settings-manager default merging tested — verify by grep 'default\|merge' in test
2 SHOULD-have test files created: [configuration-service.test.ts, profile-manager-service.test.ts] — if effort allows
All tests pass — verify by npx vitest run src/config src/services/settings src/services/profile-manager (exit code 0)

New test file (SHOULD): basic read/write config, singleton pattern verification
New test file (SHOULD): profile CRUD operations, profile switching
